program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
    (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length cells) 2)
          (let* ((a (first cells))
                 (b (second cells))
                 (r0 (min (first a) (first b)))
                 (r1 (max (first a) (first b)))
                 (c0 (min (second a) (second b)))
                 (c1 (max (second a) (second b))))
            (paint-cells out
                         (remove-duplicates
                          (append (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c0))
                                  (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c1))
                                  (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r0 c))
                                  (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r1 c))))
                         color))
          out))))
